orientation_hints.nspect_context: NSPECT-S57Q-EI19 is the nSpect registration used for nvis-rack-status. This profile covers the nvis-rack-status repository only.
orientation_hints.revision_note: repo.revision is the main-branch snapshot this profile was aligned to, not a live always-HEAD pointer. repo.branch is the canonical product branch (main); the reconstruction work was authored on feat/agentic-plc-security.
orientation_hints.scope_note: Reconstruction scope for this pass was security only: local advisory scans (SAST, dependency CVE, license, Pulse secret scan) plus a SecNemo Agent-TAVA threat model. The SRD, SADD and SUTP were deliberately not reconstructed and are marked missing rather than unknown.
integration_points: SSH to cluster head node and compute trays (host_exec / transport)
open_questions: Is nvis-rack-status a standalone nSpect product under NSPECT-S57Q-EI19, or one component of a larger NVIS OVA program registration?
Should the two sibling deployments (nvis-mel01 worktree: Firmus MEL01, Boston BOS01) be covered by this same registration or their own?
